# IPV6\_INT\_SIZE variable

Bytes in a binary IPv6 address: 16.

**Signature:**

```typescript
IPV6_INT_SIZE = 16
```

## Remarks

The IPv6 counterpart of [IPV4\_INT\_SIZE](/api/net/latest/net.ipv4_int_size/)<!-- -->. Because a network record stores a start and an end address, an IPv6 record occupies 32 bytes against IPv4's 8 — which is why [NetworkList](/api/net/latest/net.networklist/) keeps the two families in separate buffers rather than one mixed list.
